programmes.programName: Computational Science: Computational and Applied Mathematics, Ph.D.
programmes.specialization: Operations research and optimization (doctoral research area)
programmes.evidence: Current official graduate inventory expanded programme explicitly states Mathematics research includes operations research and optimization, is essential component of this doctoral programme, and students can pursue research across these areas under mathematics faculty supervision.
limitations: Programme listed under College of Engineering and Computer Science in graduate inventory while research unit is Department of Mathematics; exact cross-college administrative hierarchy not independently resolved.

branches.conclusion: Current complete graduate inventory lists only masters and certificate offerings for Rollins College of Business, no business doctoral programme.

Current engineering doctoral inventory lists three Computational Science doctorates; expanded Computational and Applied Mathematics programme explicitly includes OR/optimization doctoral research. Engineering Management offerings are masters/certificates, not PhDs.

sources.note: Full college-organized graduate inventory read and Computational Science Applied Mathematics doctorate expanded, including explicit doctoral research areas and admissions.

limitations: Exact cross-college Mathematics administrative host unresolved; academic unit and relevant doctoral research route directly verified.
